svg.title: How a cloud browser reaches websites through a proxy
svg.desc: The cloud browser sends its traffic down one of three routes to the website. 1, the default: a US residential proxy, proxyCountryCode "us", or another country code such as "de"; the website sees a residential IP in that country, not your server. 2: your own proxy, customProxy with host and port; the website sees your proxy's IP. 3: proxyCountryCode null turns the proxy off; the website sees the browser's own IP. 4: customProxy overrides proxyCountryCode and must be passed again when a follow-up starts a new browser.
svg.text: re-send it when a new browser starts
